name: Kaori
source:
The protagonist's younger sister who attends high school. [url=/c99739]Ayako[/url] borrows her sister's real name to use as her professional pseudonym. Will the real Kaori get angry at her if she catches her?

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20060207232233/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/hansoku.htm]Official Website[/url].]
